f.title: Access EudraVigilance to the extent necessary for pharmacovigilance obligations
f.statement: Under Article 24(2) of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004, EudraVigilance is accessible to MAHs to the extent necessary for them to comply with their pharmacovigilance obligations.
f.clause: 2. Scope
f.legal_basis: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Art 24(2) (cited in the preceding sentence)
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0001 in the previous version.

rows.quote: It shall also be accessible to MAHs to the extent necessary for them to comply with their pharmacovigilance obligations.
rows.location: 2. Scope
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: access right framed as 'shall be accessible'; Permitted for the MAH.

f.title: Adequately document individual cases and follow-up per IR 520/2012 and GVP Module VI
f.statement: Stakeholders with EudraVigilance reporting obligations (MAHs or Member States) are responsible for adequately documenting individual cases and follow-up information in accordance with Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 520/2012 and GVP Module VI.
f.clause: 5.1. EudraVigilance and Medicinal Products for Human Use
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0002 in the previous version.

rows.location: 5.1. EudraVigilance and Medicinal Products for Human Use
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the lead-in naming the responsibility. Double-check: 'responsibilities' = Mandatory, as in Rev 4.

f.title: Apply the latest MedDRA coding per IR 520/2012 and the Term Selection Points to Consider
f.statement: Stakeholders with EudraVigilance reporting obligations are responsible for applying the latest MedDRA coding in accordance with Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 520/2012 and the MedDRA Term Selection Points to Consider document.

f.title: Operate local duplicate detection and adhere to reporting timelines
f.statement: Stakeholders with EudraVigilance reporting obligations are responsible for operating local duplicate detection and management procedures and adhering to the reporting timelines of suspected serious and non-serious adverse reactions.
f.clause: 5.1. EudraVigilance and Medicinal Products for Human Use
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0004 in the previous version.

f.title: Comply with GDPR and national data protection law when reporting to EudraVigilance
f.statement: Stakeholders with EudraVigilance reporting obligations are responsible for complying with personal data protection requirements in the GDPR and any applicable national data protection legislation.
f.clause: 5.1. EudraVigilance and Medicinal Products for Human Use
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0005 in the previous version.

rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: as Rev 4.

f.statement: MAHs (with the Agency, EEA regulatory authorities, academia and WHO-UMC) are responsible for ensuring confidentiality of ICSR data and protecting personal data in accordance with applicable data protection law, and for implementing appropriate technical and organisational measures against unauthorised or unlawful access, disclosure, dissemination, alteration, destruction or accidental loss.

rows.quote: Marketing authorisation holders shall establish procedures in order to obtain accurate and verifiable data for the scientific evaluation of suspected adverse reaction reports.
rows.location: Annex A, I. General Adverse Reaction Reporting Principles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'shall' = Mandatory.

f.title: Collect follow-up information and submit updates to EudraVigilance
f.statement: MAHs shall also collect follow-up information on suspected adverse reaction reports and submit the updates to the EudraVigilance database.
f.clause: Annex A, I. General Adverse Reaction Reporting Principles
f.legal_basis: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Art 24 (as cited in Annex A)
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0034 in the previous version.

rows.quote: They shall also collect follow-up information on these reports and submit the updates to the Eudravigilance database.
rows.location: Annex A, I. General Adverse Reaction Reporting Principles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'shall' = Mandatory.

f.title: Correct and retransmit ICSRs classified as Error Reports
f.statement: If an ICSR is classified as an Error Report, the sender is required to correct and retransmit it before it is further processed in EudraVigilance.
f.clause: Annex A, II. Individual cases, ICSRs and classification rules
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0024 in the previous version.

rows.quote: If an ICSR is classified as ‘Error Report’, the sender is required to correct the ICSR and retransmit it before it will be further processed in EudraVigilance.
rows.location: Annex A, II. Individual cases, ICSRs and classification rules
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'is required' = Mandatory.

f.title: Confirm the PV purpose and give MAH identity details before Level 2B access
f.statement: Before being granted Level 2B access, the MAH shall provide EMA with a confirmation that either the initial signal management steps in GVP Module IX have been performed (with a reference to the corresponding e-RMR if applicable), or a review of ICSR data is warranted in a pharmacovigilance assessment procedure such as the PSUR (GVP Module VII) or when required by the PRAC in a referral or signal assessment procedure, together with elements of the MAH identity (organisation ID at headquarter level, name and contact details as in the EudraVigilance registration).
f.clause: Annex C – Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking for MAHs, Access to the ICSR data set Level 2B under the policy
f.change_summary: Unchanged in substance; the Rev 5 row now quotes both confirmation options (signal management steps or assessment procedure) with the 'shall provide' lead-in.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0033 in the previous version.

rows.location: Annex C – Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking for MAHs, Access to the ICSR data set Level 2B under the policy
rows.change_note: Unchanged in substance; the Rev 5 row now quotes both confirmation options (signal management steps or assessment procedure) with the 'shall provide' lead-in.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to include the lead-in and the signal-management option. Double-check: 'shall' = Mandatory.

f.title: Provide a signed Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking before Level 2B access
f.statement: Before being granted Level 2B access, the MAH shall provide EMA with a copy of the Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking signed by the EU QPPV and, where different, by the deputy or any other personnel under the EU QPPV's strict responsibility who is registered with EudraVigilance, holds a valid user ID and password and obtains Level 2B access (which includes a case narrative).
f.clause: Annex C – Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking for MAHs, Access to the ICSR data set Level 2B under the policy
f.change_summary: Undertaking renamed 'Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking'.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0025 in the previous version.

rows.quote: A copy of the Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking signed by the EU QPPV and where different, by the Deputy appointed by the EU QPPV or any other personnel, under the strict responsibility of the EU QPPV, who is registered with EudraVigilance and holds a valid user ID and password and obtains access to the ICSR data set Level 2B, which includes a case narrative.
rows.location: Annex C – Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking for MAHs, Access to the ICSR data set Level 2B under the policy
rows.change_note: Undertaking renamed 'Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking'.
rows.review_note: Review: no change in substance. Double-check: 'shall provide' lead-in in the preceding row.

f.title: Treat Level 2B data as confidential, use only for signal management or PV assessment, never identify data subjects
f.statement: The signatory agrees to treat all Level 2B information as confidential and use it for signal management (GVP Module IX) or a pharmacovigilance assessment procedure such as the PSUR (GVP Module VII) or when required by PRAC in a referral or signal assessment procedure, in compliance with data protection legislation, and not to seek to identify, profile, contact or target data subjects.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0026 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I agree at all times to treat as confidential all information related to the ICSR data set Level 2B and to use it for the purpose of signal management as outlined in GVP Module IX or in the context of a pharmacovigilance assessment procedure such as the Periodic Safety Update Report as outlined in GVP Module VII or when required by the PRAC in a referral or signal assessment procedure according to the conditions set in this Undertaking and in compliance with applicable data protection legislation. In particular, I agree not to seek to identify, profile, contact or target the data subjects from the Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) data set Level 2B.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.review_note: Review: no change in substance (ICSR spelt out). Double-check: undertaking terms are conditions of access = Mandatory.

f.title: Adhere to the GDPR when processing ICSRs accessed in or downloaded from EudraVigilance
f.statement: The signatory agrees to adhere to the rules of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) for the processing of ICSRs accessed in or downloaded from EudraVigilance.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.change_summary: New undertaking term in Revision 5 (update of Annex C for GDPR compliance).

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I agree to adhere to the rules set out in Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) for the processing of ICSRs accessed in or downloaded from EudraVigilance.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.change_note: New undertaking term in Revision 5 (update of Annex C for GDPR compliance).
rows.review_note: Review: new term. Double-check: Mandatory as a condition of access.

f.title: Do not transfer Level 2B data to third parties without a legal obligation
f.statement: The signatory agrees not to transfer or dispose of Level 2B data to any third party where there is no legal obligation for the MAH to do so, and shall not permit any third party to access, study, analyse, refer to or otherwise use the data or permit any party to reproduce any ICSR data.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.exceptions: Transfer permitted where the MAH has a legal obligation
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Partner & vendor oversight
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0027 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I agree not to transfer or dispose of the ICSR data set Level 2B for which access is provided under the condition of this Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking to any third party, where there are no legal obligations for the marketing authorisation holder to do so. I shall not permit any third party to access, study, analyse, refer to or otherwise use the data or permit any party to reproduce any ICSR data.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory.

f.title: Use only the minimum personal data needed and acknowledge EudraVigilance as source
f.statement: The signatory agrees to access and use only the minimal personal data necessary for pharmacovigilance activities under applicable law and to acknowledge EudraVigilance as the data source.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0028 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I agree to access and use only the minimal amount of personal data that is necessary for the performance of my pharmacovigilance activities pursuant to the applicable laws and I agree to acknowledge that the source of the data is the EudraVigilance database.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory.

f.title: Pseudonymise personal data (GDPR Art 4(5)) when reporting to third-country authorities
f.statement: The signatory shall ensure personal information is pseudonymised within the meaning of Article 4(5) of the GDPR when the MAH is legally required to report suspected adverse reactions for its EEA-authorised products to a third-country regulatory authority, so that reported personal data can no longer be attributed to a specific data subject.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.change_summary: Rev 5 adds that pseudonymisation is in the meaning of Article 4(5) of the GDPR.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0029 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I shall ensure that any personal information is pseudonymised in the meaning of Article 4(5) of the GDPR when there is a legal requirement for the marketing authorisation holder to report suspected adverse reactions for the medicinal products for which they hold a marketing authorisation in the EEA to a medicines regulatory authority in a third country. To that end, I ensure that the personal data reported can no longer be attributed to a specific data subject.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.change_note: Rev 5 adds that pseudonymisation is in the meaning of Article 4(5) of the GDPR.
rows.review_note: Review: legal basis added. Double-check: 'shall' = Mandatory.

f.title: Maintain security measures for Level 2B data and notify the Agency of breaches
f.statement: The signatory agrees to maintain adequate technical and security measures to prevent unauthorised or unlawful access, disclosure, dissemination, alteration, destruction, accidental loss or copying of Level 2B data, in accordance with applicable data protection legislation, and to immediately notify the Agency of a breach of security leading to any of these.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA
f.change_summary: Unchanged in the source; the Rev 5 row now also quotes the breach-notification clause, which the Rev 4 row cut off.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0030 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I agree to maintain adequate technical and security measures to prevent unauthorised or unlawful access, disclosure, dissemination, alteration, destruction, accidental loss or copying of the ICSR data set Level 2B, in accordance with applicable data protection legislation, and to immediately notify the Agency of a breach of security leading to any thereof.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.change_note: Unchanged in the source; the Rev 5 row now also quotes the breach-notification clause, which the Rev 4 row cut off.
rows.review_note: Review: quote completed with the breach clause. Double-check: Mandatory; 'immediately' gets no rule.

f.title: Apply the undertaking from signature and to any secondary analysis of Level 2B data
f.statement: The signatory acknowledges that the undertaking is in effect from the date of signature and that its terms apply to any secondary analysis of the Level 2B data they perform using EudraVigilance data.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0035 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I acknowledge that this Undertaking will be in effect from the date of my signature and that the terms of this Undertaking will apply to any secondary analysis of the ICSR data set Level 2B I perform using the EudraVigilance data.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory.

f.title: Comply with the undertaking as a condition of access; non-compliance may end access
f.statement: Compliance with the Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking is a condition of access to EudraVigilance, and failure to comply may result in immediate termination of the right of access and use of the data.
f.clause: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as EMA-EV-ACCESS-R4-0031 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Signatory of the MAH Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking (EU QPPV, deputy or authorised MAH personnel)
rows.quote: I understand that compliance with this Data protection and Confidentiality Undertaking is a condition of my access to the EudraVigilance database and that failure to comply may result in immediate termination of my right of access and use of the data.
rows.location: Annex C – Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection Undertaking
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory.
